items.item: A left navigation groups the settings sections
items.evidence: nav#setnav built from SECTIONS with group headings Công ty (Thông tin chung, Bản địa hóa, Thông báo), Truy cập, Rủi ro; visible in screenshot, with a select fallback below lg.

items.item: Each section uses one save model consistently (per-section save); autosave is used only for toggles and says so
items.evidence: general and locale use a sticky actionBar (Hủy / Lưu thay đổi) with dirty indicator and leave guard. notif autosaves switches (bindNotif, per-row 'Đã lưu'), and its subtitle says 'Thay đổi có hiệu lực ngay.' Minor: the digest segmented radio also autosaves, though it is not a toggle.

items.item: Localization settings show a formatted preview of a date and an amount
items.evidence: viewLocale renders dl#preview via preview(): rows Ngày (fmtDate), Giờ, Số tiền (Intl.NumberFormat currency of 1250000), Số, Tuần bắt đầu; updates live on input.

items.item: Every toggle has a visible label and states what it controls
items.evidence: Each switch row shows a visible event title plus description (e.g. 'Hóa đơn quá hạn' / 'Khi một hóa đơn quá hạn thanh toán') under visible column headers Email and Trong ứng dụng; the switch aria-label is '<event> – Email'. The locked security toggle explains itself.

items.item: The danger zone is separated at the end and its destructive action requires typing the company name or an equally strong confirmation
items.evidence: 'Vùng nguy hiểm' is the last nav group (Rủi ro) with its own red-bordered view. confirmByName() opens a dialog, 'Nhập <name> để xác nhận', and the #dok button stays disabled until the input equals the company name. It sits on a separate section rather than at the bottom of one long page.

items.item: Success is confirmed briefly; errors appear inline next to the field and persist
items.evidence: toast() auto-clears after 4000 ms and the notif rows flash 'Đã lưu' for 2 s. Errors use setErr() into #id-error beside the input with aria-invalid, cleared only when fixed, and the server-style duplicate tax code error is inline too. A summary appears only when 3 or more errors.

notes: Audit score 90, one violation (12px text in the 'SV' company logo tile). No gradient, glass, emoji, uppercase tracking, KPI tiles, greeting, promo card, hover-lift or oversized radius (all 4px, rounded-md on a few boxes). The 'SV' tile is a company logo mark, not a person avatar, so it is not counted as initials-avatar-non-person; the user avatar 'LH' is a person. Sidebar is light slate with blue-700 accent, not navy+indigo. Oddity: a visible 'Mô phỏng lỗi tải dữ liệu' demo link sits in the settings nav. The first viewport shows only the Hồ sơ công ty form, and the sticky action bar overlaps the Email field edge slightly.
